M-DOCS-CONTENT.Summary: Compiles docs/ into the site's content, search index, llms.txt and index.json, failing on any content problem.

M-DOCS-SEMANTIC-REPORT.Summary: Runs bun run telos report at build time, writes the semantic report and the build info, serves the report as /semantic-report.json, and checks that the built Verification page carries it.

M-DOCS-INSPECTOR.Summary: The inspector pages: the Locus tree and one page per Locus of the build-time semantic report.

M-DOCS-CALCULATOR.Summary: The calculator page: web forms derived from the capability contracts of calculator:arithmetic, invoked in the browser.

M-DOCS-SITE.Summary: The prerendered TanStack Start site: layout, navigation, document pages, theme, search, diagrams, verification page on the semantic report and the static server.

M-DOCS-PLAYGROUND.Summary: One page that decodes, builds, verifies and describes a JSON Locus definition with the real kernel in the browser.
